label: Battle Debris
description: The combat particulate layer — airborne evidence of violence that gives action frames their density.

items.name: shrapnel-sparks
items.text: white-hot shrapnel sparks fanning off every impact point, short violent arcs dying into thin smoke trails

items.name: concrete-dust
items.text: pulverized concrete dust rolling outward in a ground-hugging wave, whole slabs still airborne at its leading edge

items.name: tracer-lattice
items.text: tracer fire stitching bright dotted lines across the frame, ricochets kinking away at broken angles

items.name: glass-blizzard
items.text: a blizzard of shattered glass falling in sheets, every shard carrying one bright specular flash on the way down

items.name: casing-rain
items.text: brass casings raining and bouncing, spinning glints scattering around the muzzle line

items.name: hydraulic-mist
items.text: atomized hydraulic fluid venting in fine amber jets from severed lines, hanging as oily mist wherever light crosses it

items.name: sheared-plating
items.text: sheared armor plates cartwheeling away trailing rivets and torn brackets, each landing printing a fresh crater in the ground

items.name: arc-discharge
items.text: stray electrical discharge crawling over the wreckage, blue-white arcs snapping between exposed conductors and grounding out with each snap

items.name: chaff-flares
items.text: chaff ribbons and countermeasure flares drifting down, foil strips turning slowly in the air above hard magnesium points of light

items.name: oil-smoke
items.text: black oil-fire smoke columns leaning with the wind, ember cores pulsing deep inside each plume
